title: Runway Briefing — A Cockpit Attack Over Israel, Delta's Musk Meltdown, and American Squeezes More Seats Onto Its Fancy Jet
summary: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv nearly ends in disaster when one pilot allegedly tries to kill the other mid-flight — and off-duty pilots save the day. Plus, Delta's CEO reportedly torches Elon Musk to explain why Delta skipped Starlink, American strips down its most exclusive narrowbody jet, and Alaska keeps stacking up big moves days after its big product reveal.
